notes: Missing object, other-side and controlled-side objects, linked session on and off, grid cells -2..5 whose side word matches or differs in sign. Stubs log their arguments (16/8-bit ones zero-extended); 0x9e508 bumps the page word, 0x7ee8 bumps the cell word and 0x913dc moves the object, so rereads of those fields are checked, and 0x65a50 logs the 0x1a8246 byte to check the write order around it.
